messages:
Devon: quick thread to capture follow-ups from the Raven on-prem outage. Goal: owners, timelines, and short remediation checklist for VPC peering flaps + onprem MTU issues + isolation bug that showed during failover. I'll own the PM doc.
Ajay: I can take peering config + fallback routing prototype. Will open a repo PR and produce a small canary plan. ETA: EOW.
Priya: appliance firmware shows PMTUD failure and unexpected ICMP 'frag needed' during the window. Repro steps and pcap are in the doc.
Sam (support): Raven SRE scheduled packet captures for 2023-11-09 10:00 PST. I'll post S3 links.
SRE-Bot: Incident RAV-2023-09-21: postmortem draft created (auto-link: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/raven-onprem).
Maria: product request: evaluate a safe fallback to hosted for dedicated tenants when peering is down >30s. Need security review for auth/tenant invariants.
Ajay: prototype config (example): `routing { prefer: dedicated; fallback: hosted-fallback; fallback_window_ms: 30000 }` Metrics: fallback_rate, fallback_latency_penalty, tenant_errors.
Meena: I'll add MTU/PMTUD tests to infra CI and an e2e that simulates a peering flap + cache eviction. ETA: next Thu.
Devon: owners summary so far:
- Ajay: fallback prototype + canary plan (target 2023-11-07)
- Priya: root-cause note + reproduction artifact (pcap)
- Sam: customer capture coordination + upload
- Meena: infra CI tests + e2e for cache+failover
- Devon: consolidate PM + create JIRA tasks Friday
- Maria: product sign-off + loop in security
Ajay: creating INF-8812 for peering health checks and alerts (path MTU probe + BGP neighbor flap detection). Assign to eng-infra. ETA: 2w.
Priya: small diag extract added to doc: `ICMP frag needed, mtu 1400` and retrans patterns around 14:22. That aligns with model reloads we saw.
Maria: note: any fallback must preserve model pinning and token scoping; security will confirm.
Devon: please react with :eyes: to the line you own so I can convert to tracked Jira items. I'll run a 30m sync next Tue to review canary plan and test status.
Ajay: :eyes:
Priya: :eyes:
Sam (support): :eyes:
Meena: :eyes:
Maria: :eyes:
Devon: thanks everyone. If new blockers appear, reply here or DM. (automated): this thread will be archived after 7d inactivity.
